toolName: X vs. Y Comparison Page & Matrix Builder

intro: Spot overlapping articles competing for the same query in Google Search Console and decide whether to merge + 301 redirect or differentiate their scope.

intro: Design scalable template libraries, prompt hubs, and technical glossaries where every generated page provides unique data, examples, and utility.
